Name: Kenneth's Cartoon Capers
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Cartoon Capers[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]I put together 10 cartoon-inspired tracks for the Mini-Jukebox. The idea was to make the valley feel a bit more playful, like those goofy chase scenes and silly Saturday morning vibes.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Includes:[/b][/size]

[b][size=4]Bubble Pop Dance[/size][/b]
[size=4][b]Cartoon Crusader[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Fumbling Hero[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Mischief In Motion[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Playful Chase[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Pop Party[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Silly Stroll[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Sneaky Steps[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Whimsy Run[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Wobbly Adventure[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]All tracks show up in the Mini-Jukebox and are ready to play.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements: SMAPI and Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Install: Just drop it in your Mods folder.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]It only adds new tracks, nothing is replaced, and it's safe for existing saves.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Hope you enjoy it.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Compatibility: All of my music mods are separate packs but fully compatible. You can install just one or all of them at the same time with no conflicts.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Cartoon Capers[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Merry Christmas[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Neon Nights[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Fantasy Realms[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Haunted Nights[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Lofi Farm Beats[/b][/size]
